name: Giedi Prime
tagline: The Industrial Center, Home of House Harkonnen

landmarks.name: Harko City
landmarks.subtitle: The Baron's Megalopolis
landmarks.summary: A sprawling, brutalist industrial complex that serves as the capital and primary manufacturing hub.
landmarks.lore: Dominated by the massive Keep of the Baron, the city's skies are permanently choked with smog from the unending weapons manufacturing lines below.

gallery.caption: Smokestacks towering over the brutalist architecture

landmarks.name: The Barony Gladiator Arena
landmarks.subtitle: Entertainment District
landmarks.summary: A massive, triangular amphitheater used for blood sports to entertain the Harkonnen elite.
landmarks.lore: Fighters from across the galaxy, often prisoners of war, are thrown into this arena for the Baron's amusement and to keep the local populace pacified by violence.

gallery.caption: The dark, obsidian walls of the fighting pits
